title: gameStep
responsibility: Advance deterministic independent mechanics and checkpoint actions while preserving progress per game view.

inputs.name: createRun.seed
inputs.description: Initial seed used to initialize the deterministic run; it defaults to 1 and is converted to an unsigned 32-bit integer.

inputs.name: createRun.view
inputs.description: Optional view used to initialize view markers and level identity; if it has a world, its spawn x and z set the initial coordinates.

planning.description: A small cave with a single entrance.

inputs.name: stepGame.run
inputs.description: Run whose state and tick are advanced; its completion list is stored under the prior view id before the active view's progress is restored.

inputs.name: stepGame.input
inputs.description: Per-tick input with x and y deltas; non-finite deltas make stepGame throw, and a frozen copy is passed to mechanics or the built-in step.

inputs.name: stepGame.view
inputs.description: Active view must pass LevelValidator.isReady or stepGame throws; its id is written into state, and its world provides spawn reset and movement bounds when built-in movement is selected.

inputs.name: stepGame.mechanics
inputs.description: When present, this list replaces the built-in step; entries are sorted by id and receive the same frozen state and input snapshot, and overlapping or unsafe state writes throw.

inputs.name: enterView.run
inputs.description: Run whose completed-checkpoint list is saved under its prior view id before the destination view's progress is restored.

inputs.name: enterView.id
inputs.description: Destination view id written to the state and used to restore its saved completed-checkpoint list, defaulting to an empty list.

outputs.name: createRun
outputs.description: Fresh run starts at tick 0 with an unsigned 32-bit seed, default state, and empty completed, events, and trace arrays; a supplied view with a world adds view and level markers and uses its spawn coordinates.

outputs.name: stepGame
outputs.description: Next run after one call: tick increases by one, the seed advances with xorshift32, and checkpointGraph evaluates the updated run against the view.

outputs.name: gameStep
outputs.description: Alias of stepGame; calling it uses the same tick update and validation behavior.

outputs.name: enterView
outputs.description: Run with state.view and viewId set to the destination; previous completions are saved in progress, and destination completions are restored or set to an empty list.

errors.name: GameStepRefusedError
errors.description: stepGame throws Error when the view is not ready or either movement delta is non-finite; mechanic patches also throw Error for duplicate writes or the unsafe state keys __proto__, constructor, and prototype.
